market_question: Will another country leave OPEC in 2026?
reasoning: UAE's exit is already accounted for; another withdrawal in 2026 is unlikely given the rarity of OPEC exits (only a handful in decades). No other member has signaled intent, and the remaining countries have strong institutional ties or no immediate incentive. A 31.5% implied probability overprices a second exit within the same year.
evidence_points: Only 11 other OPEC members remain, most with no history of testing withdrawal.
No credible reports or official hints of another exit since UAE's announcement.
Historical pattern: Qatar (2019), Angola (2023), UAE (2026) are spaced years apart, not coincident.
sources_consulted: Historical OPEC withdrawal events (e.g., Reuters archives)
Current geopolitical analysis of energy alliances
